game.name: Doloc Town
game.intro: Doloc Town is a side-scrolling pixel-art farming sim set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland. Play as a young scavenger who builds a vertical farm one platform at a time under extreme weather: acid rain, scorching heat and thunderstorms. Gather 40+ resources, fish, ranch, modify crop genes, fight alongside your drone and automate production with solar and wind power. The 1.0 full release on August 6, 2026 adds a complete story ending, the Old City Ruins area, farming automation and 37 new achievements.
keyFacts: 1.0 full release: August 6, 2026 with complete story ending
30+ hours of core gameplay, 100+ hours of additional content
Farming automation: solar + wind power → drone stations (new in 1.0)
Crop gene system: ~20 mutations across 30+ crops
Extreme weather you can turn to your advantage (acid rain, storms, drought)
80 Steam achievements total (43 base + 37 new in 1.0)
aboutPoints: Doloc Town is developed by RedSaw Games Studio and published by Logoi Games with Pathea Games as co-publisher.
The game left Early Access on August 6, 2026 after launching in EA on May 8, 2025.
Information on this site is fact-checked against the official Steam store page, official 1.0 announcement, publisher news and reputable media (CGMagazine, PCGamesN, RPGamer).
Community-sourced details are marked with a ⚠️ note until verified by hands-on play.

introI18n.es: Doloc Town es un simulador de granja pixel-art de scroll lateral ambientado en un páramo postapocalíptico. Juegas como un joven recolector que construye una granja vertical bajo clima extremo: lluvia ácida, calor abrasador y tormentas. Reúne más de 40 recursos, pesca, cría ganado, modifica genes, lucha con tu dron y automatiza con energía solar y eólica. El 1.0 (6 ago 2026) añade el final completo, las Ruinas de la Ciudad Vieja, la automatización y 37 logros.

pages.title: How to Play Doloc Town
pages.metaTitle: How to Play Doloc Town: Complete Beginner's Guide (1.0)
pages.metaDescription: New to Doloc Town? Learn the scavenge-farm-build-explore loop, vertical farms, extreme weather tricks, drone combat basics and 1.0 automation in this full beginner's guide.
pages.intro: Doloc Town mixes a side-scrolling platformer with a post-apocalyptic farming sim. You start as a scavenger and end as a farming tycoon — here is the full loop, from day one to drones.

sections.heading: The Five-Step Core Loop
sections.body: Every session follows the same rhythm. Master it and the wasteland becomes a farm.
items: Break debris and abandoned structures in the wasteland to open paths and reveal resources.
Collect 40+ minerals, plants, scraps and machine parts. Out here even junk has a purpose.
Craft planters and stack platforms to build your farm upward — more space for crops and survival.
Spend resources on the tech tree, blueprints, buildings and your home.
Use upgraded tools and your drone to reach places you couldn't before, including the 1.0 Old City Ruins.

sections.heading: Vertical Farming Basics
sections.body: Doloc Town's signature is building up, not out.
items: Craft planters and place them on stacked platforms to expand your farm vertically.
Jump and climb between levels — platforming is part of the farming.
Protect crops from acid rain, scorching heat and thunderstorms with covers and placement.
Sow, water and harvest by hand at first; drones take over after 1.0 automation.

sections.heading: Weather Effects at a Glance
sections.body: Extreme weather is dangerous — but you can weaponize it.
columns: How to turn it to your advantage
rows: Build covers; collect acid as a resource
Time watering; plant heat-resistant gene strains
Harness lightning to power your farm
Let it irrigate fields for free
Stockpile and sell high during the price surge

sections.heading: First Week Priorities (Do This First)
sections.body: These five moves set up the whole run.
items: More build space = more crops = faster progress.
Build a planter and plant fast crops
Friendship unlocks recipes, tech and story — including Blooming Friendship.
Bellad's tasks pay Tech Points for the tech tree.
Drought prices make a hoard profitable.

sections.heading: Drone Combat for Beginners
sections.body: Your drone is your weapon and your survival tool.
items: RMB locks on, LMB shoots, Space dodges, R reloads.
Upgrade chassis, barrels and batteries for fire rate, damage and energy.
Charge beam (F) breaks shields on armored Scavenger Bugs.
Fit weapon and lighting modules before exploring ruins.

sections.heading: What the 1.0 Release Changes for New Players
sections.body: The 1.0 update (August 6, 2026) adds a complete story ending, the Old City Ruins region, farming automation (solar + wind → drone stations), the Mushroom Fest and 37 new achievements. If you are starting now, you can automate chores much earlier than Early Access players could. ⚠️ Exact unlock order is still being verified in 1.0.

sections.heading: Quick Answers
items: Yes. The developers have confirmed the 1.0 release is a single-player experience; co-op/multiplayer may be discussed later based on community feedback.
Do I need to water every day?
Yes at the start — but the 'Rain' mutation auto-waters neighbors, and 1.0 drone stations automate watering entirely.
You stack platforms within your farm area. The Old City Ruins (1.0) adds new buildable zones and resources.
30+ hours for the core story, 100+ hours with fishing, ranching, genes and collections.

pages.title: Doloc Town Farming Automation Guide (1.0)
pages.metaTitle: Doloc Town Farming Automation: Solar, Wind & Drones (1.0)
pages.metaDescription: How farming automation works in Doloc Town 1.0: build solar and wind power, deploy farming drone stations and let drones seed, nurture and harvest for you.
pages.intro: The 1.0 release turns you from a farmer into a farm manager. Here is how to generate clean energy, deploy drone stations and automate the whole crop cycle.

sections.heading: How Farming Automation Works
sections.body: Automation has three layers: energy, stations and drones.
items: Build solar panels and wind turbines to generate clean energy for your farm.
Stations are the control point that lets drones run farm operations.
Drones handle seeding, nurturing plants and gathering yields end-to-end.
While drones work, explore, talk to townsfolk or push the story.

sections.heading: Solar vs Wind: What to Build First
sections.body: Start with whichever matches your weather, then balance.
items: Solar panels shine in clear weather and pair with sunny seasons.
Wind turbines keep producing through storms — great in storm-heavy months.
A mix of both keeps energy stable across all weather.
⚠️ Exact build costs and energy values are being verified in 1.0.

sections.heading: The Industrial Zone & Conveyor Belts
sections.body: Automation isn't only for crops.
items: Start the generator in the industrial area
This powers the new conveyor-belt production line.
The industrial line grants access to new parts of the map.

sections.heading: Why This Page Matters
sections.body: English guides for Doloc Town automation are virtually non-existent — most coverage stops at Early Access basics. This page is one of the first 1.0-specific automation references in English. Details marked ⚠️ will be updated after hands-on verification.

pages.title: Doloc Town Gene System Guide: Mutations & Seeds
pages.metaTitle: Doloc Town Gene System: Mutations & Seeds Guide
pages.metaDescription: How the Doloc Town crop gene system works: gene modules, ~20 mutations like Spore Burst and Rain, seed mother plants, and how to breed stronger crops.
pages.intro: Reclaim pre-apocalypse tech and rewrite the genetics of 30+ crops. Gene modules stack up to three per seed and unlock mutations that change how your farm behaves.

sections.heading: How the Gene System Works
sections.body: Every seed can carry up to three gene modules. The right combo turns a plain crop into a self-watering, self-replicating machine.
items: Use gene readers, replicators and synthesizers to inspect and breed seeds.
Unlock seed mother plants via the shop, Aurora seed research and wild mothers.
Stack up to 3 modules per seed — synergy matters more than raw power.
⚠️ Exact module sources are still being verified in 1.0.

sections.heading: How to Breed Stronger Seeds
sections.body: Follow the mother-plant pipeline.
items: Buy from the shop, complete Aurora seed research, or find wild mothers.
Use the gene reader to pull modules.
Watch mutation synergy on your farm.

sections.heading: Pro Tips
sections.body: Pair Rain with auto-harvest mutations for a nearly hands-free plot. Gift of Time rewards long runs — plant it early. ⚠️ Community-sourced; verify in your own save.

pages.intro: Quick, sourced answers to the questions players ask most about Doloc Town.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
items: No. The developers have stated the 1.0 release is a single-player experience; co-op and multiplayer will be discussed later based on community feedback.
Is Doloc Town Steam Deck Verified?
It is listed as 'Playable' on Steam Deck, not 'Verified'. The team plans to address known issues and pursue Verified status in future updates.
How much does Doloc Town cost?
¥58.00 on Steam, with a 20% launch discount (¥46.40) running until August 19, 2026.
30+ hours for the core story; 100+ hours with all the extras.
Is there romance in Doloc Town?
No — the developers confirmed there is no romance/marriage system. Social play is friendship-based.
PC (Windows) via Steam. Minimum specs: i3 6100, 8GB RAM, GTX 460, DX11, 2GB storage.
Yes — new in 1.0. Solar and wind power drive farming drone stations that seed, nurture and harvest automatically.
Old City Ruins, complete story ending, farming automation, Mushroom Fest, new tools/drones/fish/accessories and 37 new achievements.

sections.heading: Note
sections.body: Only minimum requirements are listed on the official Steam page; recommended specs have not been published. The game is lightweight enough to run on modest hardware — and is 'Playable' on Steam Deck.

pages.intro: Doloc Town runs on Steam Deck, but it's officially 'Playable' rather than 'Verified'. Here's what that means.

sections.heading: Current Status
items: Officially listed as 'Playable' on Steam Deck.
The team says issues are likely pending optimizations, not bugs.
They plan to address known issues and pursue Verified status in future updates.

sections.heading: Tip
sections.body: If you hit trouble on Deck, check for updates first — the devs have said pending optimizations are the usual cause.
